entities.name: Planeswalker spark
entities.description: A latent power inborn in very few sentient creatures which, if ignited, makes the bearer a Planeswalker.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes whose aether imprints the spark on a soul.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Her spark was magically transferred to Slobad.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: Received Glissa's spark and used it to heal Glissa.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Contained the spark of Altair of Coloni.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Whose spark Ravidel contained.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Contained the spark of Glacian.

entities.name: Glacian
entities.description: Whose spark Yawgmoth contained.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon and former human who re-ignited his spark.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: An angel and former human with a spark.

entities.name: Ishikari Bindra
entities.description: An inventor from Avishkar who created the artificial Aetherspark and died in the process.

entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: An artificial spark made from a piece of the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Contributed time magic to safe spark extraction.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: Contributed ghost magic to spark extraction.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Dragon who performed the Elderspell during the War of the Spark and was desparked and sealed away.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Ugin desparked and sealed Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Jace sealed away Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Phyrexian who found a way to compleat planeswalkers without losing their spark.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: His spark was needed to purify corrupted souls in de-compleating.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who was de-compleated.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who was de-compleated.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Had her spark encased within a hedron, which she unwittingly destroyed.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Conflict on Ravnica in which Nicol Bolas harvested planeswalker sparks.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: Nicol Bolas' spell that harvested sparks from planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which most Planeswalkers lost their sparks.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: Event after which the spark no longer grants invulnerability or immortality.
